checks.name: Sales rows equal every agency, route and month, minus Sunbelt's two missing months
checks.why: This check catches a load that adds or drops sales rows, because the count has to equal every agency, route and month that reported.

checks.name: One row per agency, route and month, with no repeats
checks.why: This check finds an agency, route and month that has more than one row, because a sum would count those sales twice.

checks.name: Every sales row has a seats row
checks.why: This check finds a sales row with no seats row for its route and month, because the fair share calculation would leave that sale out.

checks.name: No empty sales numbers
checks.why: This check finds an empty sales number, because a sum skips it without an error and the share built from it would be wrong.

checks.name: AA is never above the market in revenue or passengers
checks.why: This check catches columns that a load swapped, because the market numbers include AA and so cannot be lower than the AA numbers.

checks.name: Both facts end in September 2026
checks.why: This check catches a table that stops before the newest month, because fair share needs sales and seats for the same month.

checks.name: Cleaning removed the duplicates' revenue
checks.why: This check catches a cleaning step that removes more or less than the duplicate tickets, because the revenue it removes must equal their fares.

checks.name: Pace never counts more months than the calendar has
checks.why: This check catches a pace calculation that counts a month twice, because the months an agency reported cannot be more than the months of the year so far.

agency_q3_aa_share_atlantic.grain: Atlantic Premier Travel, Q3 2026, all routes together: AA revenue over everything the agency sold.
agency_q3_aa_share_atlantic.sql:
SELECT ROUND(100 * SUM(s.aa_revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(s.market_revenue), 0), 1) AS value
FROM aa_demo.gold.fact_agency_sales_monthly s
JOIN aa_demo.gold.dim_agency a ON a.agency_id = s.agency_id
JOIN aa_demo.gold.fact_market_capacity c ON c.market_id = s.market_id AND c.sales_month = s.sales_month
WHERE a.agency_name = 'Atlantic Premier Travel'
  AND s.sales_month BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-09-01'

SELECT ROUND(100 * SUM(s.aa_revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(s.market_revenue), 0), 1) AS value
FROM aa_demo.gold.fact_agency_sales_monthly s
JOIN aa_demo.gold.dim_agency a ON a.agency_id = s.agency_id
JOIN aa_demo.gold.fact_market_capacity c ON c.market_id = s.market_id AND c.sales_month = s.sales_month
WHERE a.agency_name = 'Lone Star Travel Group'
  AND s.sales_month BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-09-01'

avg_of_shares_q3.grain: Q3 2026, all routes: the plain average of each agency's AA share, one share per agency.
avg_of_shares_q3.sql:
SELECT ROUND(100 * AVG(share), 1) AS value
FROM (SELECT agency_id, SUM(aa_revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(market_revenue), 0) AS share
      FROM aa_demo.gold.fact_agency_sales_monthly
      WHERE sales_month BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-09-01'
      GROUP BY agency_id) AS t

WHERE table_catalog = 'aa_demo' AND table_schema = 'bronze'

capacity_rows.grain: Rows in gold.fact_market_capacity, one per route and month.
capacity_rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM aa_demo.gold.fact_market_capacity

channel_direct_rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM aa_demo.bronze.fact_corporate_bookings WHERE channel = 'Direct'

channel_ndc_rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM aa_demo.bronze.fact_corporate_bookings WHERE channel = ' ndc '

channel_spellings_delivered.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT channel) AS value FROM aa_demo.bronze.fact_corporate_bookings

coastal_low_usd.grain: Coastal Media Group: its lowest month of corporate bookings, fare times tickets on the tickets booked in the month, in dollars.
coastal_low_usd.sql:
SELECT ROUND(MIN(t.usd)) AS value
FROM (SELECT SUM(b.fare_usd * b.ticket_count) AS usd
      FROM aa_demo.gold.fact_corporate_bookings b
      JOIN aa_demo.gold.dim_corporate c ON c.corp_id = b.corp_id
      WHERE c.corp_name = 'Coastal Media Group'
      GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', b.booking_date)) AS t

duplicate_tickets.grain: Booking rows that cleaning dropped because the ticket was already loaded.
duplicate_tickets.sql:
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aa_demo.bronze.fact_corporate_bookings)
     - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aa_demo.silver.fact_corporate_bookings) AS value

duplicate_usd.grain: Fare times tickets on the rows that cleaning dropped, in dollars and cents.
duplicate_usd.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(fare_usd * ticket_count), 2) AS value
FROM (SELECT fare_usd, ticket_count,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ticket_number ORDER BY booking_id) AS n
      FROM aa_demo.bronze.fact_corporate_bookings) AS t
WHERE n > 1

      JOIN aa_demo.gold.dim_corporate c ON c.corp_id = b.corp_id
      WHERE c.corp_name = 'Northwind Logistics'
      GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', b.booking_date)) AS t

others_apr26_chg_usd.grain: Every agency except Sunbelt Vacations and Harbor Business Travel, added up, Apr 2026: the change in AA revenue against Apr 2025.
others_apr26_chg_usd.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.sales_month = DATE '2026-04-01' THEN s.aa_revenue END)
           - SUM(CASE WHEN s.sales_month = DATE '2025-04-01' THEN s.aa_revenue END)) AS value
FROM aa_demo.gold.fact_agency_sales_monthly s
JOIN aa_demo.gold.dim_agency a ON a.agency_id = s.agency_id
WHERE a.agency_name NOT IN ('Sunbelt Vacations', 'Harbor Business Travel')
  AND s.sales_month IN (DATE '2025-04-01', DATE '2026-04-01')

others_mar26_chg_usd.grain: Every agency except Sunbelt Vacations and Harbor Business Travel, added up, Mar 2026: the change in AA revenue against Mar 2025.
others_mar26_chg_usd.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.sales_month = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN s.aa_revenue END)
           - SUM(CASE WHEN s.sales_month = DATE '2025-03-01' THEN s.aa_revenue END)) AS value
FROM aa_demo.gold.fact_agency_sales_monthly s
JOIN aa_demo.gold.dim_agency a ON a.agency_id = s.agency_id
WHERE a.agency_name NOT IN ('Sunbelt Vacations', 'Harbor Business Travel')
  AND s.sales_month IN (DATE '2025-03-01', DATE '2026-03-01')

pax_rev_max_gap_pts.grain: Q3 2026, all routes, per agency: the largest gap between passenger share and revenue share, in points.
pax_rev_max_gap_pts.sql:
SELECT ROUND(MAX(ABS(rev_share - pax_share)), 1) AS value
FROM (SELECT agency_id,
             100 * SUM(aa_revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(market_revenue), 0) AS rev_share,
             100.0 * SUM(aa_pax) / NULLIF(SUM(market_pax), 0) AS pax_share
      FROM aa_demo.gold.fact_agency_sales_monthly
      WHERE sales_month BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-09-01'
      GROUP BY agency_id) AS t

routes.grain: Rows in gold.dim_market, one per route.
routes.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM aa_demo.gold.dim_market

sales_rows.grain: Rows in gold.fact_agency_sales_monthly, one per agency, route and month.
sales_rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM aa_demo.gold.fact_agency_sales_monthly

share_of_total_q3.grain: Q3 2026, all routes: AA's share of the combined sales of all agencies, a ratio of sums.
share_of_total_q3.sql:
SELECT ROUND(100 * SUM(aa_revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(market_revenue), 0), 1) AS value
FROM aa_demo.gold.fact_agency_sales_monthly
WHERE sales_month BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-09-01'

summit_q3_aa_share.grain: Summit Travel Partners on DFW-ORD, Q3 2026: AA revenue over everything Summit sold on the route.
summit_q3_aa_share.sql:
SELECT ROUND(100 * SUM(s.aa_revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(s.market_revenue), 0), 1) AS value
FROM aa_demo.gold.fact_agency_sales_monthly s
JOIN aa_demo.gold.dim_agency a ON a.agency_id = s.agency_id
JOIN aa_demo.gold.dim_market m ON m.market_id = s.market_id
JOIN aa_demo.gold.fact_market_capacity c ON c.market_id = s.market_id AND c.sales_month = s.sales_month
WHERE a.agency_name = 'Summit Travel Partners' AND m.origin = 'DFW' AND m.dest = 'ORD'
  AND s.sales_month BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-09-01'

summit_q3_fair_share.grain: Summit Travel Partners on DFW-ORD, Q3 2026: AA's seat share (made up) weighted by what Summit sold.
summit_q3_fair_share.sql:
SELECT ROUND(100 * SUM(s.market_revenue * c.aa_seat_share) / NULLIF(SUM(s.market_revenue), 0), 1) AS value
FROM aa_demo.gold.fact_agency_sales_monthly s
JOIN aa_demo.gold.dim_agency a ON a.agency_id = s.agency_id
JOIN aa_demo.gold.dim_market m ON m.market_id = s.market_id
JOIN aa_demo.gold.fact_market_capacity c ON c.market_id = s.market_id AND c.sales_month = s.sales_month
WHERE a.agency_name = 'Summit Travel Partners' AND m.origin = 'DFW' AND m.dest = 'ORD'
  AND s.sales_month BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-09-01'

summit_q3_gap_pts.grain: Summit Travel Partners on DFW-ORD, Q3 2026: AA share minus fair share, in points. Fair share comes from made-up seat shares.
summit_q3_gap_pts.sql:
SELECT ROUND(100 * (SUM(s.aa_revenue) - SUM(s.market_revenue * c.aa_seat_share)) / NULLIF(SUM(s.market_revenue), 0), 1) AS value
FROM aa_demo.gold.fact_agency_sales_monthly s
JOIN aa_demo.gold.dim_agency a ON a.agency_id = s.agency_id
JOIN aa_demo.gold.dim_market m ON m.market_id = s.market_id
JOIN aa_demo.gold.fact_market_capacity c ON c.market_id = s.market_id AND c.sales_month = s.sales_month
WHERE a.agency_name = 'Summit Travel Partners' AND m.origin = 'DFW' AND m.dest = 'ORD'
  AND s.sales_month BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-09-01'

summit_q3_gap_usd.grain: Summit Travel Partners on DFW-ORD, Q3 2026: AA revenue minus the revenue fair share would bring. Fair share comes from made-up seat shares.
summit_q3_gap_usd.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(s.aa_revenue) - SUM(s.market_revenue * c.aa_seat_share)) AS value
FROM aa_demo.gold.fact_agency_sales_monthly s
JOIN aa_demo.gold.dim_agency a ON a.agency_id = s.agency_id
JOIN aa_demo.gold.dim_market m ON m.market_id = s.market_id
JOIN aa_demo.gold.fact_market_capacity c ON c.market_id = s.market_id AND c.sales_month = s.sales_month
WHERE a.agency_name = 'Summit Travel Partners' AND m.origin = 'DFW' AND m.dest = 'ORD'
  AND s.sales_month BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-09-01'

summit_q3_pax_share.grain: Summit Travel Partners on DFW-ORD, Q3 2026: AA passengers over all passengers Summit booked on the route.
summit_q3_pax_share.sql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.aa_pax) / NULLIF(SUM(s.market_pax), 0), 1) AS value
FROM aa_demo.gold.fact_agency_sales_monthly s
JOIN aa_demo.gold.dim_agency a ON a.agency_id = s.agency_id
JOIN aa_demo.gold.dim_market m ON m.market_id = s.market_id
JOIN aa_demo.gold.fact_market_capacity c ON c.market_id = s.market_id AND c.sales_month = s.sales_month
WHERE a.agency_name = 'Summit Travel Partners' AND m.origin = 'DFW' AND m.dest = 'ORD'
  AND s.sales_month BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-09-01'

sunbelt_missing_rows.grain: Agency, route and month rows that should exist for Sunbelt Vacations and do not.
sunbelt_missing_rows.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value
FROM aa_demo.gold.dim_agency a
CROSS JOIN aa_demo.gold.dim_market m
CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT sales_month FROM aa_demo.gold.fact_agency_sales_monthly) d
LEFT JOIN aa_demo.gold.fact_agency_sales_monthly s
       ON s.agency_id = a.agency_id AND s.market_id = m.market_id AND s.sales_month = d.sales_month
WHERE a.agency_name = 'Sunbelt Vacations' AND s.agency_id IS NULL
